state.command: id; getenforce; getprop ro.build.fingerprint; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime; dumpsys battery

power-supply.command: for p in /sys/class/power_supply/*; do echo "=== $p ==="; readlink -f "$p"; ls -1 "$p"; echo UEVENT; cat "$p/uevent"; done

monitor-interfaces.command: for p in /sys/class/hwmon/* /sys/bus/iio/devices/iio:device*; do [ -e "$p" ] || continue; echo "=== $p ==="; cat "$p/name"; ls -1 "$p"; done; echo DEBUGFS; ls -1 /sys/kernel/debug; echo PMIC_PATHS; find /sys/devices/platform -maxdepth 3 -type d | grep -Ei "pmic|power.?monitor|power.?stat|qcom,spmi|odpm|qti.*power|energy"

services.command: service list | grep -Ei "power|health|thermal"; dumpsys -l | grep -Ei "power|health|thermal"; timeout -s KILL 5 lshal | grep -Ei "power.stats|health"
